title: S20 — CORROSION: the one wall both readers fail (0/8 classic, 0/8 vision)
desc: Evidence (S19/hybrid-union): corrosion is the ONLY family where the classic floor (0/8) and the vision reader (0/8, mean char 0.877) both fail. Every other family has at least one reader scoring. Corrosion is a classifier wall (S7 diagnosis: stroke-level damage). Approach ideas to sweep with proofs: (1) stroke-damage restoration before classification, (2) family-conditioned CNN trained on corrosion-degraded glyphs (scott's v3 lane has the pipeline), (3) multi-read consensus. Three-run proof + gallery per the honesty rule. This one family blocks hard 95 alone if unresolvable by residue work.
